edge.scene: Joining device sessions to Auth.js deadlines
edge.trigger: An ordinary session reaches two hours since its last valid activity, or a remembered device reaches either seven days of idleness or the 30-day absolute deadline from first issuance
edge.expect: The server rejects authorization and clears cookies in writable responses. JWT and Set-Cookie expiry must not exceed that device's actually allowed deadline. Refresh cannot extend the absolute cap.
